definitions.explanation: A quadrilateral with four equal sides and four right angles.

notes:
{正方形|せいほうけい} is the mathematical term for a square. Composed of ⟦{正|せい}→正：noentry⟧ (correct, regular) + ⟦{方形|ほうけい}→方形：noentry⟧ (rectangle). A special case of ⟦{長方形|ちょうほうけい}→長方形：05439_chouhoukei⟧ where all sides are equal.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {正方形|せいほうけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧: area of a square
- {正方形|せいほうけい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut into a square
- {正方形|せいほうけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧: square shape

RELATED SHAPE TERMS:
- ⟦{長方形|ちょうほうけい}→長方形：05439_chouhoukei⟧: rectangle
- ⟦{四角形|しかくけい}→四角形：05437_shikakukei⟧: quadrilateral (general)
- ⟦{三角形|さんかくけい}→三角形：05436_sankakukei⟧: triangle
- ⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧/⟦{丸|まる}→丸：02167_maru⟧: circle
- ⟦{菱形|ひしがた}→菱形：16999_hishigata⟧: rhombus/diamond

CONTRAST:
⟦{四角|しかく}い→四角い：05917_shikakui⟧ is the everyday adjective for "square-shaped," while {正方形|せいほうけい} is the precise geometric term.
